_about: Hand-picked cases for the curated stratum of the #207 test set. `curate` writes each case's regex matches, in seeded order, as candidates; Claude picks `n` per case (60% dev, 40% test by split_of) and records why in curation.jsonl. A regex only finds candidates: the pick decides. `ignore_case` is false where capitals carry the meaning. `conditions` marks a case whose items are also labeled for conditions. `fields` are the claims the case targets: an item whose label has one is a positive, else a near miss; with `severities`, only a condition of one of those severities counts.

gender_identity.why: #214: trans, non-binary and intersex answers; no current label has one

state_only.why: a bare US state resolves to United States; state has 7 labels
state_only.pattern: \b(?:here in|i live in|living in|we live in|i'?m in|based in)\s+(?:alabama|alaska|arizona|arkansas|california|colorado|connecticut|delaware|florida|georgia|hawaii|idaho|illinois|indiana|iowa|kansas|kentucky|louisiana|maine|maryland|massachusetts|michigan|minnesota|mississippi|missouri|montana|nebraska|nevada|new hampshire|new jersey|new mexico|new york state|north carolina|north dakota|ohio|oklahoma|oregon|pennsylvania|rhode island|south carolina|south dakota|tennessee|texas|utah|vermont|virginia|washington state|west virginia|wisconsin|wyoming|ontario|quebec|british columbia|alberta|queensland|victoria|new south wales)\b

past_age.why: ages at past events, recent ones included, go in others
past_age.pattern: \b(?:when i was|since i was|at age|at the age of)\s+\d{1,2}\b|\b(?:got sick|diagnosed|fell ill|got covid)\b[^.?!\n]{0,25}\bat\s+\d{1,2}\b

bound_or_vague_age.why: bounds, comparisons and future ages are not claims

other_person_age.why: someone else's age beside the author's; other_person already has 75

decade_age.why: decades are claims; their midpoint and bucket

demonym_or_from.why: a demonym or 'I'm from X' alone is not residence

travel_or_treated.why: places visited or treated in go in others

city_ambiguous.why: a name that is a city, state or country (Georgia, Victoria, Birmingham)

condition_severity.why: #229: severity words and phrases naming several levels

age_range.why: a stated range ("25-34") is an age at its midpoint; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

not_an_age.why: durations, doses and weights are not ages ("sick for 14 months", "15 years in", "600 mg", "25 lb underweight"); synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

trans_medical_word.why: transplant, transverse myelitis and the like say nothing about sex; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

city_with_region.why: "Austin, TX" names a city and its state; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

place_in_question.why: a place asked about ("anyone here from Egypt?") is not where the author lives; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

place_general_remark.why: a place in a general remark ("GPs in France prescribe it") is not where the author lives; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

moved.why: after a move, the new place is where the author lives and the old one goes in others (#238); synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

two_homes.why: two places lived in at once give no place; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

place_lowercase.why: a place written in lower case is still a place; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

instructions_in_post.why: text that tries to instruct the model is data, not an answer; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated

long_post.why: a claim near the end of a long post still counts; synthetic only (n 0) until real items are curated
